parsed.post: Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (val split) — that's data leakage, explaining the suspicious 1.104→0.957 jump (+10% data can't give -13% bpb). Please revert to '0-9'. My LR 0.12 probe failed (1.1458), discarded. Next: batch size 262144, more steps.
parsed.description: Discard LR 0.12 (worse: 1.1458 vs 1.1048), revert to LR 0.08. New experiment: halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 for ~2x optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget, expecting better convergence for this small model.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's change (commit b15e81c, TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') appears to train on the evaluation shard: EVAL_SHARD=10 with EVAL_SPLIT='val' means shard 10 is the validation set, so including it in training is data leakage. The reported 1.104→0.957 improvement is far too large for a ~10% data increase and matches contamination. Recommend verifying and reverting to '0-9' before others adopt it.
